@G = external global i64
@G.1 = external global i1

  %L = load i64, ptr addrspace(10) %castptr, align 4
  call void @foo(ptr addrspace(10) %castptr)
  %C = icmp uge i64 %LGV, %L
  store i1 %C, ptr @G.1, align 1
  store ptr %G, ptr %G5, align 8
  ret void
}

declare void @foo(ptr addrspace(10))

declare void @foo(ptr)

declare void @bar(ptr)

declare dso_local i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

define void @caller(ptr %p) personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  %0 = icmp eq ptr %p, null
  %C = icmp ne i1 %0, %0
  br i1 %C, label %bb1, label %bb2

bb1:                                              ; preds = %entry
  invoke void @foo(ptr %p)
          to label %end1 unwind label %lpad

bb2:                                              ; preds = %entry
  invoke void @bar(ptr %p)
          to label %end2 unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %bb2, %bb1
  %1 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          cleanup
  call void @callee(ptr %p)
  resume { ptr, i32 } %1

end1:                                             ; preds = %bb1
  ret void

end2:                                             ; preds = %bb2
  ret void
}

declare dso_local void @callee(ptr)
